$comment: MCP servers bundled with this site for ANY coding agent. Rendered into each agent's project config by `pnpm agents:port` (Claude .mcp.json, Codex .codex/config.toml, OpenCode opencode.json, Antigravity .agents/mcp_config.json). No secret values: bearer tokens are ENV VAR NAMES resolved by the agent at runtime; OAuth servers prompt a browser login on first use. default_profiles = what THIS site uses (template ships ['core']); --profile overrides once.

site.description: This site's MCP server (/api/mcp, Streamable HTTP): page sections, blog, jobs, short links, products and prices, settings and flags. Auth: Bearer SITE_MCP_KEY (= the site's MCP_SECRET_KEY) + X-Caller-Label.

cloudflare-api.description: Cloudflare zone/account API: cache rules, purge, DNS, redirects.

coolify.description: Coolify v4: apps, deployments, logs, env vars.

supabase.description: Supabase cloud: projects, SQL, logs, edge functions.

whatsapp-business-tools.description: Meta's WhatsApp Business Tools MCP: numbers, templates, webhooks.

postiz.description: Postiz (self-hosted social scheduler) MCP: create and schedule posts across connected social accounts. Key = Postiz Settings > Public API.

n8n.description: n8n instance MCP: list and run workflows exposed to MCP. Token = n8n Settings > Instance-level MCP.
